resources.string: Explore approved services. No location or account information is collected in guest mode.
Live catalog is not connected. An approved HTTPS API origin must be configured at build time.
Choose the matching service category to continue.
Could not load the requested page. No changes were made.
No public listings are available for this category.
Development preview • Worker functions require configured Google OAuth and a reachable approved HTTPS backend.
This view reads only approved, active Categories from the configured JODLO API.
Sign in to manage your own worker draft and listings. No separate worker account is required.
Google Sign-In is not configured. This preview cannot create a real session yet.
Sign-in was not completed. No worker access granted.
Signed in. Check your worker profile to continue.
Signed out locally. Remote revocation may need verification.
Check your existing worker draft before continuing.
Worker mode is optional. Opting in creates a private draft, not verified status.
Private worker draft confirmed by server.
Worker draft is active. Publishing requires an approved Category.

Use the same fresh public Service check as a Customer. Only approved Service information may appear: Category, reviewed description, optional city and photo. Worker credentials and call availability are not verified.
Public when last checked. Only independently reviewed Service details are shown; this does not verify Worker identity or authorize contact.
This service is not currently public. It may be unpublished, hidden or unavailable. No reason is disclosed here.
Could not confirm public visibility. Do not assume it is public or hidden; try again.
Choose an approved active Category. Publishing is not identity verification.
Search in Hindi or English across approved active Categories. A Category can be selected even if nobody has published it yet.
No approved Categories matched this search. Try a different term or browse all.
No approved active Categories are available yet. Services can be published after Category review and activation.
Could not verify this Category page. Earlier results remain visible; retry or start a new search.
Could not verify current data; nothing has been changed.
Operation not confirmed. Review current status before trying again.
Server confirmed the change. Review My listings and check the current Customer view; refresh again if the list is missing.
Unconfirmed change: %1$s. Only an explicit read can show current owner status.
This Service could not be found in your current account. It does not establish what happened to the previous change.
Could not obtain a trustworthy owner read. The earlier change remains unconfirmed.
Owner pages checked on this manual scan: %1$d
A matching Service currently appears visible to the owner.
A matching Service currently appears non-public to the owner.
No matching Service was observed on the checked page.
This scan reached a last page or found a match; the earlier change is still unconfirmed.
More owner pages may exist. Each check reads only one page.
Network result uncertain: the change MAY have happened. Do not retry it automatically.
Current visibility is not proof that the prior write committed.
Uncertainty acknowledged, not resolved. Recheck server state before a new action.
Worker Google sign-in requires a configured JODLO API and Google client. Internet voice calls, location discovery and payments are not yet available.
Google sign-in is verified by the JODLO API. Internet voice calls, location discovery and payments are not yet available.
Next page could not be verified. Earlier rows remain visible; use Refresh if listings have changed.
SAMPLE DATA ONLY • Not real workers or approved live Categories. This preview makes no network requests and cannot call, sign in or publish.
This listing is no longer public. Return to the category and refresh.
Only the service Category and reference are public. No worker contact, identity verification or call availability is confirmed here.
Sign in with Google to view your account. The same account works for Customer and optional Worker mode.
Only you can view this account summary. Counts reflect current JODLO records, not identity verification or availability to take calls.
Current account data could not be confirmed. No change was made.
Could not confirm your call preference. Check again.

Incoming call consent is on, but Android has blocked JODLO call notifications. You may miss incoming calls. Allow notifications in your phone settings. Delivery is not guaranteed when the app is closed.
Check this sign-in\'s call device registration
A call notification device is registered for this sign-in. Actual Firebase delivery has not been verified.
No call notification device is registered for this sign-in. Incoming call alerts may not arrive.
Registration was requested. Check again to confirm whether the server accepted it.
Could not check device registration. Calling may not be enabled on the server. Check again.
All active sessions were revoked by the server.
Signed out on this phone. Server-wide revocation could not be confirmed.
Sign-in confirmed by JODLO. Refresh to see current account information.
Sign-in could not be confirmed. No account access was granted.
Save a copy of my account data
This permanently deletes your active JODLO database account, services and sessions. It does not delete backups, external provider records or files on this phone.
Your active JODLO database account was deleted and signed out.
Account deletion is not available on this server yet.
The server declined the deletion request. Start a fresh review if you still want to delete the account.
Google confirmation was not completed for the current account.
The server could not confirm the result. Check your current account before requesting deletion again.

Your file may contain Google identity and account references. Select a private storage location; cloud destinations may upload the file. JODLO exports current database records only, not provider or backup records.
Your account data was saved to the location you selected.
Your data file could not be saved. If a partial file was created, delete it from the selected location.
Your account session changed; the old export was discarded. Sign in and try again.
Step 1 complete: you selected an approved service category. Check it before making your listing public.
Confirm that this is the work you offer. Publishing uses your shared Worker account and only the approved Category. No location, price, experience or photos are collected in this version.
Customers currently see the Category and a Listing reference only. Publication is not identity verification or permission to start calls.
Unpublishing removes this service from public discovery. Confirm only if you want to stop showing this listing. This does not delete your account.
Step 3 — Review selected Category and continue
A Service with this Category already appears in your loaded My Services. Select another Category or review the existing Service. The server will also check all your Services.
Only a currently approved Category can be saved. Check the exact scope before you continue.

Public when eligible: the approved Category and an opaque Service reference. A publish or edit may be rejected or later hidden by the server; it is not Worker verification, online status or calling permission.

Not collected or editable in this version: Worker name, work description, experience, rate, location or service area, photos, phone, verification or contact. These need separate approval, consent and moderation; this review does not grant them.
Edit existing service · choose a new category
Select an active, approved replacement category from the search/browse list below. Your existing service reference stays the same. No phone, rate, experience, address or trust information is changed.
Choose another approved category below to continue.
Saving will immediately change the category of your existing public service. If another device changed this service, the server will reject this edit. Recheck your own listings and select again.
This work may already be in My Services, or its category may be unavailable. Check My Services before starting again.
This service changed or is unavailable. Review its current status in My Services before trying again.
This service has changed, its replacement category is unavailable, or you already listed that work. Refresh My Services and start a new edit. No duplicate save was attempted.

These are private bookmarks of public service references on this phone only. No Google sign-in, location, syncing or sharing. A bookmark never means the Worker is verified, currently available or ready to receive calls. Open each service to check current public status.
No services saved yet. Open a public service in Customer and tap Save.
Saved reference — current public status has not been checked.
Save this service on my device
Could not update device Saved items. No change was confirmed.
Could not save this service. Device storage may be unavailable, or you have reached the 50-item limit.
Remove every saved service reference from this phone? Your public services and JODLO account will not be changed.
Saved services on this device were cleared.
This exact service is currently returned by the public JODLO API. This is not contact or call permission.
The saved service is no longer public under its saved Category. It may have been unpublished, hidden or edited. You may remove the bookmark.
Current status could not be confirmed. The saved reference is not proof the service is available.
A configured live HTTPS JODLO API is needed to verify a saved service. Bookmarks can still be removed locally.
Optional: after a short pause, your typed work text is sent to the JODLO API for public Category suggestions. No account or location is sent. Switch this off anytime.
Debug sample suggestions only. Typed text stays offline in this preview.
Several possible work categories. Choose the right one.
Open this Category. No automatic listing, posting or call.
No live Category suggestion yet. Try a different work description or use Search.
Live suggestions could not be checked. You can still use the Search button.

Optional: asks JODLO only for these public Category IDs and their approved names in the selected language. No saved service ID, Worker account, login or location is sent. A Category name does not confirm a service is public or available.
Category names could not be verified. Technical IDs are still shown; no service visibility has been assumed.
For safety, this lookup resolves up to 50 different Categories at a time. Other IDs remain visible.

Only currently published, eligible public service references are shown. No location, account, phone number, verified identity or calling availability is requested. Open one service to check its current public status before saving.
This page could not continue. Refresh for the latest public services.
No public services are available yet. Categories must first be approved and Workers must publish eligible services.
Open to verify the current public listing. No call or contact is initiated.
Choose a city manually. JODLO sends it only when you request city results and does not request GPS or an address.
No city selected. You can still browse all public services without location.
Verified nearby workers cannot be shown yet. Worker service areas, city coverage and matching rules need separate privacy and moderation approval. This does not mean no worker exists in your city.
No listings are labelled nearby, sorted by distance or claimed to serve this city. A published Category or Service reference is not a service-area confirmation.
Browse all public services (no city filter)
The next screen is not filtered to your selected city. Open a Service to check only its current public Category and reference; availability, area and calls remain unverified.
Find the controls that exist today. This is product help, not a final legal Privacy Policy, Terms of Service or a staffed support channel.

Guest browsing and approved Category search do not require sign-in or GPS. An active Category or public Service reference does not establish Worker identity, current availability or permission to call.

Bookmarks are stored only on this device, not synced to your account. Open Saved to check public status, remove individual references or clear them. You can also Hide an unwanted Service locally and later restore it in Hidden; this is not a server block or report. Clearing Saved does not erase account or provider records.

After Google sign-in, Account can export current JODLO database records to a document location you choose and sign out on all devices. Exports may include private identity details; choosing cloud storage can upload the file. An export does not cover external providers or backups.

Worker mode uses the same account. Workers can inspect their owned services and explicitly pause or edit an approved Category. Publishing is not identity verification. Real in-app voice calls and Nearby Worker matching are not available.

Full account deletion, backup/provider erasure, abuse reports, appeals and a verified staffed support contact have not yet been implemented or approved. Export and sign-out do NOT delete account data. No deletion request is submitted by opening this screen.
Legal Privacy Policy, Terms, data-retention windows and support contact still require review before public release. Do not treat this help page as those legal documents.

Hide only changes what this installation displays in Customer Browse, Feed and Saved. It does NOT report or block a Worker, modify the server, prevent new listings, delete Saved bookmarks or sync across devices/accounts. Clearing app data may reset your hidden list.
No Services hidden on this phone.
Hide this Service on this phone
Service can appear in future results again. Current eligibility is not verified.
Service hidden locally. An existing Saved bookmark is kept and can reappear after unhide.
Could not update the hidden list on this phone. Storage may be unavailable or the 100-entry limit reached.
Services in this loaded page were hidden on this phone. More public results may exist; choose More to continue.
%1$d Saved Service references are hidden on this phone. They are still bookmarked; use Hidden to restore them.
Show all locally hidden Services again? This does not change public eligibility, delete bookmarks or send a report.
All local hidden IDs cleared. Services may appear in future public results.

These are only public Service reference IDs saved on this phone. No Google account, private Worker data or GPS is included. You choose a document location; a cloud storage choice may upload the file. JODLO does not sync it automatically. Restoring references does not verify current Services.
On this phone: %1$d Saved and %2$d Hidden references
Your chosen destination receives one JSON copy of both local lists. The file may reveal your service interests, so keep it private. The file is not a backup of your JODLO account or provider records.
Choose where to save the backup
Choose a JODLO public-reference backup. The file is checked strictly; nothing is restored just by opening it. Import never contacts a server. Only additional valid IDs can be merged.
This file contains %1$d Saved and %2$d Hidden public references.

Merge Saved and Hidden separately by tapping each button. Existing local entries remain; duplicate IDs are skipped. Conflicting Saved Categories or exceeded limits block that merge. Neither merge proves a Service is public today.
Merge Saved references on this phone
Merge Hidden references on this phone
Document selection cancelled. No local data changed.
The lists changed while choosing a destination. Export cancelled; choose again for a fresh copy.
Backup written to the selected document. Keep it private.
Could not save the backup to that document. The destination may contain an incomplete file; delete it in the document provider if needed.
Invalid, unsupported or oversized file. No Saved or Hidden entry changed.
File checked. Review the counts and choose each merge explicitly.
This merge is unavailable: a Saved Category conflicts or the 50 Saved / 100 Hidden limit would be exceeded. Existing data stays unchanged.
All these references are already present. Nothing changed.
Saved references merged locally. No server verification or synchronization happened.
Hidden references merged locally. No Worker was blocked or reported.
Could not commit this list on this phone. No successful restore is claimed; the other list was not altered by this action.
Browse approved work categories or open all public services. No sign-in or location is required to discover services.
Offer a service as a Worker
Only active approved categories are shown. A category does not mean a Worker is online, verified or ready to take a call.
Open current public listings for this category
A configured JODLO HTTPS API is required for live categories. The Customer screen can offer a separate offline developer sample in a debug build.

This service is not currently public. That does not prove it was paused: moderation or inactive Category may also hide it. Reactivation is allowed only for an earlier unpublished service, not a hidden or unapproved one.

If the server confirms this exact existing service is unpublished, still approved and allowed, it will become public immediately with the SAME Listing reference. No new service or verified Worker profile will be created. An unavailable or changed service will be rejected.

Private management status: Published means you have not paused the Service. Public visibility is checked separately and can be denied by the active Category or moderation. Only your own paused Services can be resumed.
Published, but not publicly visible. This does not indicate that you paused it. It may have a Category or moderation restriction. Reactivation is not applicable.
Current approved Category name (not a verified Worker profile or guarantee of availability).

Check up to 10 saved services per tap using one fresh public-only request each. These temporary results are from the time checked, are never saved or synced, and are not Worker availability, identity or call permission. A network error is NOT proof a service was removed.
Public when checked: %1$d · Not public when checked: %2$d · Could not confirm: %3$d
Public at last check only. Open to verify again.
Not public at last check. It may be unpublished or restricted; bookmark remains on this device.
Could not confirm at last check. This does not mean the service was removed.
Category and any reviewed Service details above came from the same fresh public read, not from the private Worker editor.
Find work by Group and Family
Only separately approved Group, Family and active Category mappings appear. This is not Worker availability, verification or contact permission. You can always browse all approved Categories instead.
Browse and search all approved Categories
No approved mapping at this level yet. All Categories remain available through regular Browse.
This API version does not provide approved hierarchy yet. Use Browse Categories; no data was changed.
Refresh this selected service from my account
Read-only current owner status at the last check. This is not a verified identity, proof a previous write committed, or live Customer visibility.
This service matches the latest private server read. For Customer visibility, perform a separate public check.
This service changed since the earlier owner page. The old edit/review was cleared; review the current Category and status before any new action.
The selected service is no longer available to this account. The old selection was cleared; no write was performed.
Could not verify the selected service. The server may be offline or not support this exact read yet. No write was performed; existing Category editing still uses its server-side conflict checks.
Fresh private revision verified. Choose a new approved Category, review and confirm. Another device can still change this Service; the server will reject a stale edit.
This Service changed on the server. The earlier review was cleared. Check the current status and begin again.
Could not verify the current service before changing its publication status. Try again.
Could not verify an edit revision. This API may be older or unavailable. No edit was sent; versioned editing cannot safely fall back.
This edit requires a fresh private revision and server conflict check. If the Service changed since review, the edit is rejected. Do not retry an uncertain write automatically.
Worker identity and experience: no approved public Worker profile or verification is available for this Service.
Service area: no approved city, address or distance is supplied. Choosing a city in Nearby does not verify this Service covers it.
Rates, photos and contact: not supplied or verified here. Internet voice calls are not currently enabled.
Approved category name could not be checked
This is an approved Category label, not Worker identity verification. Any reviewed Service details appear separately; an unchecked reference is not proof of current publication.
This exact service was public at the time of its latest check. It may change afterward.
This is only a service reference. Open it to check whether it is public now.
No verified Worker identity, rating, price, address, contact or calling availability is provided.
Find saved Services on this device
Find hidden Service reference on this device
No local match. Your saved data has not changed.

Find and order only the displayed bookmarks on this device. Approved Category names may be searched after you explicitly check them. This does not filter the full public-status review or change anything on the server.
Find and order only local hidden IDs. This does not unhide, remove, block or report a Worker.

These filters affect only the displayed owner list. The server may change visibility later; the eligible filter does not verify a public Customer view or calling. Already selected service management stays separate.
Additional Services are not loaded yet. Load the next page to include them in the local filter.
No matching loaded services. This does not delete or unpublish any Service.
Saved in this file: %1$d already on this phone, %2$d additional. Successful merge would total %3$d (limit 50).
Hidden in this file: %1$d already on this phone, %2$d additional. Successful merge would total %3$d (limit 100).
Saved merge blocked: an existing ID has a different Category. It will not be overwritten.
Saved merge blocked: its result would exceed the 50-reference limit.
Hidden merge blocked: its result would exceed the 100-reference limit.
If you merge both lists, %1$d Saved references will still be hidden locally. They are not deleted and their public status remains unchecked.
Hidden merge blocked: long reference IDs would exceed this phone’s 10 KiB private storage format. Existing Hidden references are unchanged.
The account session or Worker data changed. The earlier private summary was hidden from this screen; no account data was deleted. Refresh the current account before exporting.
Publication status: not confirmed. Refresh My Services before managing it.
Your account or Worker data changed. An older private Service list is hidden; nothing was deleted.

Categories with public services in this city
Only categories with currently public Worker-declared city services are listed. This does not verify distance, online status or call availability. Opening a service checks it again.
No approved categories currently have public services in this city.
Could not confirm the city\'s categories. Refresh or try again; previous category choices may have changed.
Saving a city lets customers find this service in that city. Choose No city to remove it from city search. No address or GPS is shared.
Could not confirm the service city. Reload the current area before changing it again.
